text:
alex_partnerships: FYI — Nimbus Cloud wants a private offer for our upcoming joint launch. Need alignment on commit tiers + renewal language. Timeline: Nimbus wants offer live + co-announcement on May 12.

maria_finance: How aggressive on discounts? What's our GTM ask from Nimbus on co-sell?

jordan_sales: They asked for a headline 35% off for 1-year committed spend $250k+. Flexible tranches ok. They also want a pilot/POC discount and SI credits.

sam_legal: Heads-up on legal: avoid open-ended auto-renewals. Recommend 1-year terms, renewal opt-in with explicit notice windows (60 days). Also need clause for force-majeure / regulatory cost pass-through.

rita_si_lead: SI channel asks: deal registration + 10% implementation credits first year. Prefer rebate paid on invoice rather than pre-paid credit.

maria_finance: Draft pricing bands for discussion:
```
Tier A: $100k - $249k -> 20% off, 6% SI rebate
Tier B: $250k - $499k -> 30% off, 8% SI rebate
Tier C: $500k+      -> 35% off, 10% SI rebate + 50 GPU credits/mo (hardware bundle)
```
Also question: who supplies the GPU credits? Nimbus or Redwood subsidy? Need clear cost allocation.

alex_partnerships: That matrix is helpful. Two asks: (1) create unique SKU per tier for marketplace listing, (2) define renewal uplift cap — propose max +10% on list price at renewal unless customer renegotiates.

sam_legal: +10% cap is okay, add carve-outs: we can exceed cap for changes in regulatory taxes or materially increased cloud costs. Will draft redline using language: "renewal pricing subject to market index adjustments not to exceed 10% without mutual written agreement."

jordan_sales: Suggest we include a one-time onboarding credit: either 1 month free for Dedicated or $20k onboarding credit for Hosted migrations. That helps close deals with lower friction.

rita_si_lead: Also request: if Nimbus-sourced pipeline >50% of ARR for a closed deal, increase SI rebate by +2% (tier-relative). Need a simple registration verification flow.

partners-bot: Reminder: internal playbook and past templates -> https://redwood.internal/marketplace/private-offers :document:  (see sample SKU naming conventions)

alex_partnerships: Action items: maria to finalize SKU -> pricing mapping by EOD Wed; sam to produce legal redline; rita to write SI incentive & registration flow; jordan to confirm headline discount for co-annc. I'll schedule a short sync Thurs 10am PT. :calendar: :clock10: 

maria_finance: Acknowledged. I'll draft the SKU file and open a PR to marketplace repo.

jordan_sales: 👍 confirming 35% headline for press but reserving right for exec approval on strategic exceptions.

sam_legal: Will post the redline here when ready.

alex_partnerships: Great — if no objections we'll lock the offer Friday and share with Nimbus for sign-off. :rocket:
